Lajjārāma
of Candana family, son of Rāma of Harighāla an. grand-father of Vīra Miśra (a. of Dhātudarpaṇa, Trav. Uni. 2048).

217.

Lajjāśaṅkara
--Gaṅgāstotra. Allahabad D. IX. 5960.
--Viśveśvarāṣṭaka. Allahabad D. IX. 5960. [Page193-b]
